issues.description: The problem text instructs students to implement singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but both the template and the provided solution declare singFarmSongVerse as private. Additionally, the UML in the problem statement shows the method as private (minus sign), which contradicts the textual instruction. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the expected API and may cause tests that call the helper method to fail if they expect it to be public.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement UML to mark singFarmSongVerse as public (plus sign) and explicitly require a public helper, and change the method declaration in both the template and solution Farm.java files to public; or (B) update the textual instruction to state the helper should be private and keep UML and code as-is. Preferred fix: change the Farm.singFarmSongVerse method modifier in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java (both template and solution) to public to match the testing instruction, and update the UML in problem_statement.md to show it as public.
